desk.title: എഴുത്തുമേശ
desk.description: Your works in progress. Pick up where you left off, or start something new.
desk.localMode: Local mode: your work is saved in this browser only.
desk.firstWorkHint: Choose a സാഹിത്യരൂപം (writing type). You can change fonts, margins and page size later.
desk.importHint: # lines become titles, ## chapters; in a screenplay, “Name: line” becomes dialogue.

trashWork.title: Move “{title}” to the trash?
trashWork.body: You can restore it from the Trash tab any time.

books.title: പുസ്തകങ്ങൾ
books.description: Collect your works into a book with covers, contents and front pages, then export it as one PDF.
books.empty: No books yet. Use “New book” to collect chapters from your works.

delete.title: Delete the book “{title}”?
delete.body: Its covers and front pages go. The works used as chapters stay on your desk.

trash.title: ചവറ്റുകുട്ട
trash.description: Works you deleted. Restore them, or empty the trash to delete them permanently.

emptyConfirm.title: Empty the trash?
emptyConfirm.body: {works} will be deleted permanently. This can’t be undone.

deleteForever.title: Delete “{title}” forever?
deleteForever.body: It will be removed with its versions and Story World. This can’t be undone.

keyboard.manglishHint: Type in English letters, get Malayalam (Ctrl/⌘ + M to switch)
keyboard.malayalamHint: Type Malayalam with a built-in keyboard layout

layouts.inscriptHint: Standard Government of India layout, the one in Windows, macOS and Linux
layouts.systemHint: Use the Malayalam keyboard set up in your system or phone

keyboard.chilluTip: Type a consonant, ് and ] for a chillu: ന ് ] → ൻ
keyboard.passThrough: If your computer already types Malayalam, Litma leaves those keys alone.

mobile.keepSelection: Your selection is kept while you use the tools.

settings.languageHint: The language of menus and buttons. Your writing is not affected.

download.title: Litma for your computer
download.body: The same Litma, as an app for Mac and Windows. Your work syncs with the web.

manglish.keysHint: Space accepts · ↑↓ or 1–7 to pick · Esc keeps English

saved.title: Saved words
saved.emptyBody: Look a word up in the dictionary and press Save. Your saved words appear here while you write.
saved.insert: Put this word in your text
saved.pickHint: Tap a word or a synonym to put it in your text.
